method: OpenAlex works, title_and_abstract.search strict pairing: ("machine learning" AND "genomics"), one filter per publication_year, meta.count server-side, fetched 2026-09-27 during a rate-limited window (single-shot requests, retry+backoff)
notes: Counts are fresh server-side meta.counts as of fetch time (2026-09-27, UTC morning).
2026 is a partial year (through late Sep).
Strict pairing is a narrower lower-bound query than the snapshot cohort filter (single AI term + single anchor term); treat series levels as indicative, growth rates as the signal.

Full per-term breakdown (AI: artificial intelligence/ML/DL x anchors: genomics/genome/precision medicine) was deferred because the OpenAlex search cluster was returning 503 for paged/full-cohort queries during this window; re-run code/fetch_build.py when healthy.
